RLEAKOFF.stands_in_for: the comparator's open output as the resistance that carries its highest stated input current from the supply; the datasheet's output leakage is smaller still, so this overstates what the open output can pull down

RSAT.stands_in_for: the comparator's asserting output as the resistance that produces its highest stated saturation voltage at the current the datasheet states that voltage for; the gate network draws far less, so the real output sits lower

RSEROFF.stands_in_for: the series element at the high end of its tolerance

RSERON.stands_in_for: the series element at the low end of its tolerance

RUPOFF.stands_in_for: the gate pull-up at the high end of its tolerance

RUPON.stands_in_for: the gate pull-up at the low end of its tolerance, which is the value that holds the gate highest when the detector is pulling it down

VBUS.stands_in_for: the source at the bottom of the Type-C range, as an ideal source with no output impedance of its own

description: the input switch's gate with the detector open and with it asserting, at the lowest input the board accepts
name: input_switch_gate_in_both_detector_states
